metadata.notes: Committed seed. Produced by the Wikidata pass in src/YuruChara.Ingestion/Wikidata/prefecture-mascots.rq (VerificationLevel.Automated for every record), then hand-checked: eleven mascots were verified field by field against the owning body's own website and promoted to VerificationLevel.ManuallyVerified. Reliability is recorded per field in sourceCitations, so an Official citation on DebutYear and an Aggregated one on Motif can sit on the same record. A prefecture with an empty mascots list is a recorded gap in the automated source, not missing work — see DATA-SOURCES.md section 4. Do not fill gaps in from memory.

mascots.motif: シラコバト (Eurasian collared dove), the prefectural bird
mascots.licenseNotes: Saitama publishes downloadable official design collections together with 使用上のきまり and a 使用取扱規程. Conditions: only the published designs may be used, no alteration, deformation or speech bubbles, specified colours only (monochrome and line art permitted), minimum height 8 mm, and the credit 埼玉県マスコット「コバトン」 must be displayed. A separate 県の承認 procedure applies to some uses, and election campaigning is excluded. Note that ImageLicenseStatus cannot express both 'assets published with terms' and 'approval needed for some uses' at once; the published-assets reading is the primary one here.
mascots.reviewNotes: Checked against Saitama Prefecture's own pages 2026-08-13. The prefecture states 生年月日：平成12年5月31日 and モチーフ：県民の鳥「シラコバト」, so Wikidata's 2000-05-31 is confirmed exactly and the motif is now specific rather than 'anthropomorphic pigeon'. Official URL corrected: Wikidata's https://www.pref.saitama.lg.jp/theme/mascot/index.html returns 404. Context from the same page: the winning design was selected on 2000-05-31 from 795 entries for the 59th National Sports Festival, named コバトン on 2001-02-21, and formally appointed the prefecture's mascot on 2005-01-04. DebutYear records the 2000 birth date the prefecture states, not the 2005 appointment.

mascots.owningBody: 公益社団法人島根県観光連盟 (Shimane Prefectural Tourism Federation)
mascots.licenseNotes: Copyright in the design is held by 公益社団法人島根県観光連盟. A 使用許諾申請 under 島根県観光キャラクター『しまねっこ』キャラクター使用に関する要綱 is mandatory for all use except news reporting and the free uses statutory copyright law allows. Both paid (有償) and free (無償) tiers exist, applicants must submit a sample of the intended use, altering the supplied artwork — including animating it — is prohibited in principle, and an approved use carries a 使用許諾番号 (島観連許諾第○○○○号).
mascots.reviewNotes: CORRECTED. The owning body is not Shimane Prefecture. The federation's own copyright statement reads 「本サイトのコンテンツの著作権は、（公社）島根県観光連盟、島根県にあります」 and the design usage page states 「デザイン等の著作権は（公社）島根県観光連盟に帰属します」, so the design copyright sits with the tourism federation, a 公益社団法人 (public-interest incorporated association), not the prefectural government. This is the only one of the eleven verified mascots not owned by its prefecture directly, and it is the reason OwningBody is free text rather than an enum. Neither page states a birth year, so DebutYear stays at Wikidata's 2010 (Aggregated, month precision). Motif is read from Wikidata's P31 class.

mascots.owningBody: 熊本県 知事公室国際・くまモン局くまモン課
mascots.licenseNotes: Illustration use requires an online 利用許諾申請, which takes roughly one month, and is limited to three purposes: PR of Kumamoto Prefecture, expanding markets for Kumamoto products, and promoting Kumamoto's industry, culture, arts, education and sport. Governed by the 利用の手引き and 利用規程. Kumamon's royalty-free reputation is a conditional arrangement inside this procedure, not an absence of one. Note that the site's own copyright notice reads © 2010 熊本県, a year earlier than the birthday the same site states.
mascots.reviewNotes: CORRECTED. Wikidata gave inception 2010 (year precision). Kumamoto Prefecture's own profile states 「2011年3月の九州新幹線全線開業をきっかけに生まれたんだモン」 and 誕生日 3月12日（九州新幹線全線開業の日）, so DebutYear is 2011. 2010 is the year the design was made and is what the site's copyright notice carries; the owning body dates the character itself to 2011, and the owning body's own date is the one this project takes. Official URL corrected: Wikidata's https://kumamon-official.jp/ returns a 301 to https://kumamon-land.jp/. Owning body established from the page footer: 熊本県知事公室国際・くまモン局くまモン課. Motif is read from Wikidata's P31 class — the official profile pointedly declines to state a species, saying only 「オスじゃなくて男の子！」.
